{{Quote|Ahsoka Tano. You have been charged with sedition against the Jedi Order and the Republic itself. This court will decide your fate.|Chancellor Palpatine's opening statement at the trial's start|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was put on '''trial''' in [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]] after she was framed for and charged with the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]] and the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] presided over the trial.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Senate believes that an internal Jedi trial would seem biased. Therefore, the Senate asks that the Council expel Ahsoka Tano from the Jedi Order so that she may be put to a Republic military tribunal, where she will receive more impartial judgment.|Admiral Tarkin|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
When [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka]] was arrested for the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple]] and for killing [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] and [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], she was held at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Admiral Tarkin contacted the Jedi Council and relayed the wish of the Senate &mdash; that Tano be expelled from the Jedi Order so that she could be tried by a military court. Following her meeting before the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], she was expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and imprisoned by [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].

==The trial==
{{Quote|A Jedi may be responsible for the murder, but that Jedi is ''not'' Ahsoka Tano. Members of the court, you are prosecuting the ''wrong'' Jedi."<br />"Well said, Senator Amidala. However, if she is innocent, then why was she seen conspiring with known Separatist terrorist Asajj Ventress?|Senator Amidala and Admiral Tarkin|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
[[File:Tano_Trial.png|thumb|left|220px|Chancellor Palpatine presided over the proceedings]]
The trial was held in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] Court Chamber. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] presided over the proceedings. Ahsoka was escorted to a floating platform where she was then moved to the center of the hall. On either side, [[Senator/Legends|senators]], who were serving as the jury, were seated in rows of ten or twelve. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] sat in another row above the Senators.

On the left side of Ahsoka, the prosecution was situated, with the lead prosecutor being [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]], who vowed to ensure Ahsoka's conviction and punishment to the fullest extent of Republic law - death. On the right side was the defense, represented by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Admiral Tarkin began the presentation, discussing facts which made Ahsoka seem clearly guilty. Ahsoka continued to argue in her defense. She attempted to explain the story while Padmé also continued to provide reasons to believe she was being framed. However, Tarkin was stubbornly unconvinced.

Meanwhile, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] had just engaged in a duel with [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], who had been the real perpetrator behind the attacks. Palpatine was about to read the verdict when Anakin and the [[Jedi Temple Guard/Legends|Jedi Temple Guards]] burst in with Barriss Offee. Barriss confessed her crimes and angrily blamed the Jedi for serving the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by fighting in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Palpatine ordered that Offee be taken away, and all charges against Tano were dropped.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I know you believe in me, Anakin, and I'm grateful for that. But this isn't about you. I can't stay here any longer, not now.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
[[File:AhsokaLeavesTheOrder-TWJ.png|thumb|right|220px|Tano leaves the Jedi Order]]
The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] personally pardoned Ahsoka and asked her to rejoin the Order, but she declined and left. Anakin followed her outside the Temple, and asked her to reconsider, noting that the idea of leaving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was something he himself struggled with. She replied that she knew, but stated that this was something she must work through on her own.
